user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Neon Arcade Room. A retro video arcade at night: rows of arcade cabinets with glowing animated screens, an air-hockey table, a prize claw machine full of plush toys, a change machine, neon wall strips and a mirror ball, and a patterned carpet in wild 90s colors. Screen glow and neon pulses light the dark room in cyan, magenta and orange. Style: neon retro. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
